d:
Varanasi, the world’s oldest inhabited city felt less like a place and more like an experience that stayed with me long after I left. And witnessing Dev Deepawali here took that feeling to another level. The ghats lit up with countless diyas, the sky bursting with fireworks, the sound of the aarti echoing across the Ganga… it was surreal, overwhelming and unlike anything I had ever felt before.
During my days here, I went through a whole spectrum of emotions and somewhere between the chaotic lanes and the quiet river, this city taught me more than I expected.
